title: Stability of halting output under extensions
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. If a choice word $w$ makes the machine halt with output $a$, then for every Boolean word $v$, the extended choice word formed by appending $v$ to $w$ also makes it halt with the same output $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output
For every choice words $w,v$ and output word $a$, if the run under $w$ halts with output $a$, then the run under $w$ followed by $v$ also halts with output $a$
